outcome: Let the Control Plane know which version each Runner is actually running, so the rule that keeps two machines on compatible schemas has something real to read.
non_goals: Do not treat a Runner's own claim about its version as authority over what it may read
Do not add a Runner aggregate wider than the version and compatibility question needs
Do not let an unreported version be indistinguishable from a compatible one

transitions.reason: the self-update design measured that no Runner reports its running version anywhere: the api layer carries only a static response schema_version and optimistic-lock expectations, and the domain has a RunnerID type but no Runner aggregate, so the cross-machine coexistence invariant has no input and the machines cannot be kept inside a common schema interval

the surface tasks all widen the same six files, so they run one at a time, each branching from the tip the previous one landed on; the order was revised so that the version report lands right after the release surface and the capture time lands right before the scheduler wiring that consumes it, which avoids shipping a snapshot builder whose every candidate carries a zero capture time
every task this one depends on is complete, so the block has cleared
Runnerのversion申告面の実装に着手

既存heartbeatへのadditive optional objectとしてbinary 2座標とschema区間の申告面を作り、side tableに保存した。partial objectは22 caseすべて400で何も保存せず、schema_max単独がinterval開始0として保存されることは無い。申告を権威にしないことをAST scan 2箇所と行動的証明で示した（宣言上限4096をschema_min=schema_max=4096として申告した不合理なRunnerが6操作すべてで同じstatus codeと同じbody byteを得る）。3状態は未申告時にinterval fieldがkeyごと不在になる形で、default intervalを作らない。intersection_stateは1台でも未申告なら unknown。canonical schema counterの所有者がtree内に無いので積集合は報告できるが何もgateしないことを専用checkで明記し、gate/permit/refuseをどこにも主張していない。productionのreport件数が0であることも専用checkで断言した。bounded enumerationはFirestore実測で65 readsがRequirement 3件でも11件でも同一と測り、成長率がmachine数のみであることを示した
